name: web_fetch
description: Fetch a public HTTP or HTTPS URL without a browser. Uses the configured reader providers (default: Jina Reader at r.jina.ai) in order; if every reader fails and ai.web.direct_fetch_fallback is enabled (default), fetches the target URL directly and strips HTML to text (public hosts only). Set ai.web.reader_providers to `direct` to skip the reader services. Returns bounded text marked as untrusted external content. An optional JINA_API_KEY environment variable enables authenticated upstream access.

url.description: Absolute public http:// or https:// URL (maximum 8192 characters).
